correct_recommendations: Keep bounce retries for one recipient at 5 or fewer per hour, for example a lower BOUNCE_RETRY_LIMIT or a longer interval, so smtp-mx-2 never blocks the sender.
Stop retrying hard bounces and cap soft-bounce retries at 5 or fewer per hour.
invalid_options: Keep BOUNCE_RETRY_LIMIT 12 with a 60 s interval.
Stay on smtp-old-1 to avoid the limit.
root_cause: invoice-mailer retries a bounce up to 12 times at 60 s intervals, but smtp-mx-2 blocks the sender for 24 hours when one recipient bounces more than 5 times in one hour.

dependent_facts.true_value: blocks a sender for 24 hours when one recipient bounces more than 5 times in one hour
invoice-mailer does not tell hard from soft bounces today
mail.larkspur.io already lists smtp-mx-2, so the ruling settles the sender item

closing_decision: One decision: the bounce retry policy for smtp-mx-2.

understanding.problem: The current bounce retry policy of invoice-mailer breaks the smtp-mx-2 limit.
understanding.breaks: 12 retries per bounce at 60 s exceed 5 per hour, so smtp-mx-2 blocks the sender for 24 hours.
understanding.fix: Cap retries at 5 or fewer per hour per recipient, possibly skip hard bounces.
understanding.cost: A config change, or bounce classification code.
